entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abū Bakr Aḥmad ibn ʿAlī al-Rāzī, widely known as al-Jaṣṣāṣ, was a leading Hanafi jurist and Qurʾān exegete in Baghdad of his time. Serving as the Mufti of Iraq, he is best known for authoring Aḥkām al-Qur'ān.
